Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The scheduler refused the job with a "gateway cron requires credentials" error, so nothing is scheduled yet and no digest will post on Monday 19 October.

I did check the two channels. #coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest can draw on both without showing anything to people who can't already see it. When it's set up, I'll leave out money terms and finance documents, since those go only to Anselm, June and the account owner.

To get it running, someone with Gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler credentials, or create the job in the Automations page. The job should run Mondays at 08:00 America/Chicago and post in #coastal-team. Once that's done, I can confirm it with a test run. Until then, I can also post a digest by hand on request.
